title: 第3章 杀鬼子就能修炼第4章 强大的惊鸿卫
slug: 一剑惊天下可她身后的男人更可怕
content_zh:
夜渐渐深了。
君傲在房间内盘膝而坐，意识沉入气海。
那里空荡荡的，没有真气流转，没有丹田吞吐。
只有一面黑色的旗，静静悬在中央，二十年来纹丝不动。
旗面是纯黑的，没有任何纹饰。
旗杆也是黑色，看不出材质。
它就这么悬着，像一口深井，吞没了所有可能。
“唉！”君傲喃喃道，“这黑旗到底是什么东西？为何不让我诞生丹田？”
“世子！好消息！”
阿三的声音从门外传来，带着急促的脚步声。
门被推开，阿三喘着气，眼睛发亮：“南城府派人来，说抓到了几个鬼子奸细！”
君傲猛地睁眼。
“走！”
……
南城府衙，灯火通明。
府尹陈文远是个四十出头的中年人，面白微胖，此刻却一脸凝重。
见君傲进来，连忙躬身：“世子，人在大牢里。一共三个，都是今天傍晚在码头抓到的，形迹可疑，说话带口音。”
“带我去看。”君傲声音很冷。
大牢在地下，阴冷潮湿，空气中弥漫着霉味和血腥味。
火把在墙壁上跳动，映出扭曲的影子。

最里面的牢房里，关着三个人。
君傲只看了一眼，心头就涌起一股强烈的厌恶……太像了。
矮，瘦，眼神躲闪又凶狠。
穿着大武百姓的粗布衣服，可那气质，那姿态，和前世记忆里那些侵略者重叠在一起。
“问出什么了？”君傲问。
陈文远苦笑：“嘴硬得很。鞭子抽、烙铁烫，就是不开口。”
君傲走到牢门前。
里面三个人同时抬头看他。
中间那个眼神最凶，嘴角还带着血，却咧开嘴笑了，用生硬的大武话说：“你……是谁？”
君傲没回答，只是盯着他。
那眼神，像在看死人。
“谁派你们来的？来了多少人？想干什么？”君傲问，声音平静得可怕。
三人都不说话。
君傲从腰间拔出匕首。
很普通的匕首，阿三平时给他防身用的。
他推开牢门，走进去。
阿三想跟，被君傲抬手拦住。
牢房里很窄，血腥味更浓。
君傲走到中间那人面前，匕首抵在他喉咙上。
“说。”

那人盯着君傲，忽然笑了，嘴里叽里咕噜冒出一串话。
是扶桑语。
君傲听不懂，但那语气里的嘲弄，谁都听得出来。
content_en:
The night is getting darker.
Jun Ao sat cross-legged in the room, his consciousness sinking into the sea of ​​energy.
It was empty there, with no infuriating energy flowing and no inhalation of Dantian.
There is only one black flag, hanging quietly in the center, motionless for twenty years.
The flag is pure black without any decoration.
The flagpole is also black and the material cannot be seen.
It just hangs like a deep well, swallowing up all possibilities.
"Alas!" Jun Ao murmured, "What on earth is this black flag? Why don't you let me have my Dantian?"
"Your Majesty! Good news!"
Ah San's voice came from outside the door, accompanied by the sound of hurried footsteps.
The door was pushed open, Ah San gasped and his eyes brightened: "Nancheng Prefecture sent someone to say that they caught several Japanese spies!"
Jun Ao opened his eyes suddenly.
"Let's go!"
…
The Nancheng government office is brightly lit.
Governor Chen Wenyuan is a middle-aged man in his early forties, with a fair face and a slightly plump face, but at this moment he has a solemn look on his face.
Seeing Jun Ao come in, he quickly bowed: "Your Majesty, we are in prison. There are three of them. They were all caught at the dock this evening. They acted suspiciously and spoke with an accent."
"Take me to see it." Jun Ao's voice was cold.
The prison was underground, cold and damp, and the air was filled with the smell of mold and blood.
Torches danced on the walls, casting twisted shadows.
There were three people in the innermost cell.
Jun Ao only glanced at it, and a strong feeling of disgust surged in his heart...it was so similar.
Short, thin, with evasive and fierce eyes.
Wearing the coarse clothes of a common man, his temperament and posture overlapped with those of the invaders in his previous life memories.
"What's the question?" Jun Ao asked.
Chen Wenyuan smiled bitterly: "You are very tough-talking. The whip is whipping and the iron is hot, but you just don't speak."
Jun Ao walked to the cell door.
The three people inside looked up at him at the same time.
The one in the middle had the most ferocious eyes, and there was blood at the corner of his mouth, but he grinned and said in a blunt and strong voice: "Who...are you?"
Jun Ao didn't answer, just stared at him.
That look was like looking at a dead person.
"Who sent you here? How many people are here? What do you want to do?" Jun Ao asked, his voice was terrifyingly calm.
None of the three spoke.
Jun Ao pulled out the dagger from his waist.
It was a very ordinary dagger, which Ah San usually gave him for self-defense.
He opened the cell door and walked in.
Ah San wanted to follow, but Jun Ao raised his hand to stop him.
The cell was very narrow and the smell of blood was even stronger.
Jun Ao walked up to the man in the middle and put the dagger at his throat.
"Say."
The man stared at Jun Ao, suddenly smiled, and murmured a string of words.
It's Fusang language.
Jun Ao couldn't understand, but everyone could hear the ridicule in his tone.
